text:
claire.pm: dropped a short design PR — main asks: make invite role-visible up front, settle SSO toggle wording, and fix keyboard nav on audit filters
nate.design: saw it. UI note: invite CTA is visually loud next to role chips. suggest mute to 'accent-muted' and add caret so it reads modal-trigger not persistent action
jess-ux: accessibility: make the role pill the activator (aria-expanded) so screen readers don't get double controls. helper text for SSO should be linked via aria-describedby
ben (eng): sounds good. backend will emit 'sso_policy_change' audit events with tenant_id, actor_id, before/after, request_id. will also add GET /audit/summary?org_id to return counts per event type
claire.pm: for invite copy: replace "Invite members by email" with "Invite by email — select role before sending" and show expiry in confirmation: "Expires in 7 days"
nate.design: small copy tweak: use "Organization members" in modal copy to avoid confusion for nested orgs
jess-ux: audit filter chips need roving tabindex + announce counts when applied: "Invites filter applied, 10 results" via aria-live. add keyboard shortcut to focus filters
ben (eng): implementation notes: inline role edit emits 'role_inline_update' with before/after; mobile fallback opens sheet. route shim for audit nav param view=auditable will be added per compliance
audit-bot: staging deploy queued after PR + docs: include API contract, ARIA mapping, and example audit payloads
claire.pm: thanks all — i'll add acceptance criteria to PRJ-9001 and ping for reviews
